prompt: Mark the trust boundaries: the browser is outside, on the public internet; everything else is in our private network.

args.source:
flowchart LR
  browser[Browser] --> lb[Load balancer]
  lb --> api[API]
  api --> db[(Database)]

checks.why: a public and a private boundary
the browser outside, the rest inside the private network

expect.$expr: (() => { const priv = v.groups.find((g) => /private|internal/i.test(g.label)).id; const p = (id) => v.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id).parentId; return p('browser') !== priv && ['lb', 'api', 'db'].every((id) => p(id) === priv); })()
